name: Na wa oo
description: Pepe hands on hips, caption 'Na wa oo'. Classic Nigerian 'this life / this person / this country' disbelief.
whenToUse: Mild shock or 'can you imagine' at news, a wild story, price, behaviour, or result: na wa, hmmm, this one is something else. Standing judgement, not collapsed defeat. Prefer this over nawa_o when the vibe is 'I am looking at you like this', not sitting on the floor tired.
whenNotToUse: Skip greetings, celebrations, or when you fully agree (use gbam/just_it). Not for grief.
